episodes.title: Wait you were in a CULT?!
episodes.description: In this episode, we talk to our homegirl Mary and she tells us about her experience in a CULT! Yes girl! A whole ass cult! In part one, she talks about how she was basically held captive in Mexico against her will and the events that led up to it and how she got out. This had to be discussed in the group chat!
